description:
Figure 7 presents a comparison of loss and accuracy metrics for Experiments 1 and 2 across 60,000 steps. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60,000, with tick labels at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis is split into two panels; the left panel is labeled “Loss” and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 1x10<sup>-5</sup> to 6x10<sup>-2</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The right panel is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.35, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  

The left panel displays two lines representing loss. A blue solid line with diamond markers represents “Ex1 Loss”, starting at approximately 5.5x10<sup>-3</sup> at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 1.5x10<sup>-4</sup> at step 60,000. A green dashed line with circular markers represents “Ex2 Loss”, starting at approximately 4.5x10<sup>-2</sup> at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 1.2x10<sup>-4</sup> at step 60,000. 

The right panel displays two lines representing accuracy. A blue solid line with diamond markers represents “Ex1 Accuracy”, starting at approximately 0.14 at step 0 and increasing to approximately 0.31 at step 60,000. A green dashed line with circular markers represents “Ex2 Accuracy”, starting at approximately 0.02 at step 0 and increasing to approximately 0.24 at step 60,000.
